{{DISPLAYTITLE:Ice Flan (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTA-IceFlan.jpg|200px|right]]
[[File:FFTA-spr-IceFlan.gif|left]]
{{Quote|Blue, jelly-like monster. Absorbs ice damage.|Description}}
The '''Ice Flan''' is an enemy in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' that is related to the [[Cream (Tactics Advance)|Cream]] and the [[Jelly (Tactics Advance)|Jelly]]. Like most jellies in the [[Final Fantasy series|''Final Fantasy'' series]], its Defense is phenomenally high, but it is extremely weak to certain elemental spells. The Ice Flan absorbs [[Ice (element)|Ice]]. It is advisable to use [[Lightning (element)|Lightning]], [[Water (element)|Water]], [[Wind (element)|Wind]], [[Earth (element)|Earth]], [[Holy (element)|Holy]], and especially [[Fire (element)|Fire]]-based spells to defeat it.
